name: A costed holding lot carries a non-null unit cost and conserves value (`depleted_stock_value + stock_value == opening_stock_value`); an uncosted lot carries null unit cost and zero placeholder values so totals withhold.

payload.rationale: A costed holding lot carries a non-null unit cost and conserves value (`depleted_stock_value + stock_value == opening_stock_value`); an uncosted lot carries null unit cost and zero placeholder values so totals withhold.

response.expression: ((((((self.cost_status == 'costed') and (self.unit_cost != null)) and (self.opening_stock_value >= 0)) and (self.depleted_stock_value >= 0)) and (self.stock_value >= 0)) and ((self.depleted_stock_value + self.stock_value) == self.opening_stock_value)) or (((((self.cost_status == 'missing_cost') and (self.unit_cost == null)) and (self.opening_stock_value == 0)) and (self.depleted_stock_value == 0)) and (self.stock_value == 0))
